== Tholina ==
First there was the [[Ribozyme]] queen.

[[File:Protocell-1.svg|thumb|Tholina in her realm]]










== Second generation ==
[[File:Protocell-2.svg|thumb]]



Tholina II had countless daughters who worked the field. She was busy making daughters and some of her daughters would have their own cells[[B vitamins]] were some of her daughters, pieces of RNA used for metabolism


Her daughters pulled in [[nucleic acids]], [[Carbohydrate|Carbohydrate,]] and [[Amino acid]] into the cell for energy

While [[fat]] was stored inside trhe cell membrane





== Third Generation ==
[[File:Protocell-3.svg|thumb|391x391px]]





[[Vitamin A]] was used in the cell membrane to generate photosynthetic power

[[Vitamin D]] was generated in the cell membrane with light and used to regulate [[Calcium in biology]]






== Fourth generation ==
[[File:Protocell-4.svg|thumb|300x300px]]












== Fifth generation ==
[[File:Protocell-5.svg|thumb|426x426px]]



Originally worker ribozymes did everything else on their own

Soon some worker ribozymes tasked with metabolizing [[Amino acid]] started building structures out of them

These structures were simple at first, for as time went on they grew more complex. At one point a general ribozyme managed to form a [[Ribosome]] which took genetic data and converted it into proteins

This allowed proteins to be made and quickly mutate instead of relying on [[RNA origami]] that more frequently failed

As a result this took over most functions from [[Ribozyme|Ribozymes]] leaving only protein transcription in place

DNA later replaced RNA because it sacrificed foldability for resilience
